items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Royal Foster now used to play in there.

ctx.x: But you could play them with your hand?

You could play with your hand during that time too if you could play. Yeah. Just lift the top off, you know, and cut that foot off while you'd wake up. You'd pedal. You could play them with your hand too. And after that, they'd raise them with some kind of, you know, put a nickel in it and it'd be by itself. And before that time, you'd pedal it, you know. They'd give a fella a dollar a night. Well, we used to play every night for a dollar a night. Yeah. During the pressing time. Yeah, I guess so. Yeah. Well, good…
